Awesome Actions

Section titled “Awesome Actions ”

A curated list of awesome things related to GitHub Actions.

Actions are triggered by GitHub platform events directly in a repo and run on-demand workflows either on Linux, Windows or macOS virtual machines or inside a container in response. With GitHub Actions you can automate your workflow from idea to production.

Official Actions

Section titled “Official Actions”

Workflow Tool Actions

Section titled “Workflow Tool Actions”

Tool actions for your workflow.

  • actions/checkout - Setup your repository on your workflow.
  • actions/upload-artifact - Upload artifacts from your workflow.
  • actions/download-artifact - Download artifacts from your build.
  • actions/cache - Cache dependencies and build outputs in GitHub Actions.
  • actions/github-script - Write a script for GitHub API and the workflow contexts.

Actions for GitHub Automation

Section titled “Actions for GitHub Automation”

Automate management for issues, pull requests, and releases.

  • actions/create-release - An Action to create releases via the GitHub Release API.
  • actions/upload-release-asset - An Action to upload a release asset via the GitHub Release API.
  • actions/first-interaction - An action for filtering pull requests and issues from first-time contributors.
  • actions/stale - Marks issues and pull requests that have not had recent interaction.
  • actions/labeler - An action for automatically labelling pull requests.
  • actions/delete-package-versions - Delete versions of a package from GitHub Packages.

Setup Actions

Section titled “Setup Actions”

Set up your GitHub Actions workflow with a specific version of your programming languages.

  • actions/setup-node: Node.js
  • actions/setup-python: Python
  • actions/setup-go: Go
  • actions/setup-dotnet: .NET core sdk
  • actions/setup-haskell: Haskell (GHC and Cabal)
  • actions/setup-java: Java
  • actions/setup-ruby: Ruby
  • actions/setup-elixir: Elixir
  • actions/setup-julia: Julia

Cookies and analytics

HagiCode uses analytics to see how this site is used. Nothing loads until you choose.

Your choice: Not chosen yet

Necessary: always on

Needed for the site to work and to remember your choices, language and theme.

  • hagicode_consent cookie
  • hagicode:consent localStorage
  • hagicode:site-locale localStorage
  • starlight-route localStorage
  • hagicode_locale_monitor cookie
  • hagicode:locale-monitor localStorage
  • hagilight-theme localStorage
  • starlight-theme localStorage
  • hagilight-content-width localStorage
  • hagilight:promoto-banner:dismissed-signature localStorage

Analytics: off until you accept

Session replay, where a provider records sessions, is part of analytics. No provider records the screen. (Google Analytics, 51LA, PostHog)

  • _ga cookie
  • _ga_<id> cookie
  • ph_<key>_posthog cookie
  • ph_<key>_posthog localStorage
  • __ph_opt_in_out_<key> localStorage
  • ph_<key>_session_registered_properties sessionStorage
  • ph_<key>_primary_window_exists sessionStorage

You can change this any time in Cookie settings.
